# Competition train.csv

- 9,500 labeled problems across 7 categories (bit manipulation, equation numeric, cryptarithm, text cipher,
  numeral system, unit conversion, gravity). Already present in our local competition data.
- LB1 used it for **statistics extraction** (skeleton sampling, rule inventories, the 77-word cipher vocabulary,
  operator priors) as well as labels — not merely as training rows.
- Public test set is tiny (3 rows, sanity only). The hidden eval set drives the real LB.
